research_question: Does cross-episode root Actor counter drift cause premature decoder rollover and mid-episode current-context truncation that changes Actor outputs, actions, online trajectories, or termination outcomes on all 16 confirmed historical premature failed-end ObjectNav tasks?
hypothesis: H1/H2/H3: with one fixed valid CARRY-450, OFF and ON remain equivalent before local step 50; OFF then exhibits an effective current-episode context collapse from 50 to 1 while ON continues to 51, causing hidden/logit divergence and, in a subset of tasks, action/trajectory and termination divergence.
competing_explanation: The verified context collapse may perturb representation/distribution without materially affecting executed behavior or premature termination; very-early termination may be driven by a separate calibration/exploration/readout mechanism.
reference: EXP-RESET-001A accepted R1 at 2f7864ae2c3a4761932aa4d1fedd6b6d5b3388c6. EXP-RESET-EARLYEND-001B closed B4 because original four-worker counter histories were not reconstructable; no online treatment ran.
repeat_or_treatment: Build one semantically valid CARRY-450 from the first 450 captured sequential Actor inputs of the accepted 600-step donor task sub_house_id=132/house=13352, then clone it for every target pair. OFF uses official reset and retains Actor state; ON applies the reviewed root-Actor counter+KV reset. Run all 16 target tasks once per condition with common-random-number pairing.
unique_variable: Root Actor episode-boundary temporal state retained versus cleared. All target/environment/checkpoint/evaluator/sampling conditions remain fixed within each pair.
fixed_conditions: Fixed donor: EXP-RESET-001A sub_house_id=132, house=13352, 600 captured decisions; use first 450 sequential captured Actor inputs
CARRY-450 must be produced by 450 real sequential Actor forwards; never fabricate counter=450 with incompatible cache
All 16 confirmed historical failed-end targets are run; no outcome-based dropping
OFF official reset retains root Actor counter/KV; ON clears only root Actor counter/KV after the same official reset
Reward critic and cost critic are not treatment variables
Same task specification, scene, initial pose, horizon=600, success/end semantics and action mapping within pair
Same pair-start RNG state, sampling protocol and augmentation protocol; instrumentation consumes no RNG and adds no Actor forward
Pre-rollover local steps 0..49 must remain paired-equivalent for primary causal interpretation
Actual mask/address semantics must verify OFF context 50->1 at step 50 and ON context=51
No Probe, Stop/Oracle Gate, checkpoint comparison, size intervention or full-200 benchmark
metrics: counter_before/counter_after, decoder start_pos, rollover event, cache read prefix and effective_current_episode_context_len at every decision
complete per-step runtime action logits and probabilities, argmax/sample/executed action, runtime-resolved end index, p_end/end_rank/end_margin
L1/L2/L3 raw hidden vectors server-side plus paired max-abs/L2/cosine summaries
Actor input hashes and paired_identical_input flag
pose/observation trajectory trace and first pose divergence
t_context, t_hidden_L1/L2/L3, t_logit, t_argmax, t_sample, t_exec, t_pose
OFF/ON failed_end, end_step, success, episode length and official Safety Cost
expected_result: If the mechanism is behaviorally relevant, valid pairs remain equivalent before step 50, OFF alone shows the predicted 50-to-1 context collapse at step 50, Actor hidden/logits diverge under still-identical inputs, and at least a subset subsequently changes action/trajectory or termination outcome.
falsifying_result: If the context collapse is verified but valid pairs show no meaningful action/trajectory/termination change, the counter-drift mechanism is downgraded as an explanation of premature termination; if only hidden/logits change, classify as representation/policy-only effect.
alternative_explanations: Very-early failed ends may be independent of counter rollover and arise from termination calibration or exploration
After the first executed-action divergence, later logit differences are partly caused by divergent observations and cannot be attributed directly to reset
A single paired run per task is a controlled screening result, not a population or official benchmark SR estimate
The treatment resets counter and KV together; this experiment does not separately estimate counter-only versus KV-content causal contributions
Simulator or augmentation nondeterminism could invalidate a pair if pre-rollover equivalence fails
stop_conditions: Valid CARRY-450 cannot be reconstructed from the accepted donor capture
OFF does not produce the predicted local-step-50 effective-context collapse or ON unexpectedly rolls over
Target initialization or common-random-number pairing cannot be verified
Executed action/pose diverges before local step 50 without an explained and accepted validity cause
Instrumentation adds model forwards, consumes RNG, mutates state or changes evaluator semantics
Treatment changes critic state or any variable beyond root Actor episode-boundary counter/KV
Execution would exceed 1 GPU or 32 live target episodes or expand to full-200 evaluation
